title: 玩家角色Boss / Characters Bosses
description:
全部 Boss 的卡组 / 遗物 / 特殊效果 / 逐回合意图（含恐惧模式加强）都可以在百科页查到：[url=https://github.com/FlyingPig114514/CharactersBosses/blob/main/docs/wiki/boss-table.md]https://github.com/FlyingPig114514/CharactersBosses/blob/main/docs/wiki/boss-table.md[/url]
Decks, relics, special effects and the full turn-by-turn script of every boss (including Dread-mode upgrades) are listed here: [url=https://github.com/FlyingPig114514/CharactersBosses/blob/main/docs/wiki/boss-table.en.md]https://github.com/FlyingPig114514/CharactersBosses/blob/main/docs/wiki/boss-table.en.md[/url]

本模组灵感来源于杀戮尖塔1代的模组崩坠。启用本模组后，你每一幕的Boss战都会被替换为由原版玩家角色扮演的Boss（可在设置中调整）。他们拥有自己的遗物、卡组，会使用自己职业的卡牌。与玩家不完全相同的是，他们的出牌受到一定程度的限制，但最大生命值更多并且每个都有独特的特殊效果。

This mod is inspired by the Slay the Spire mod Downfall. With it enabled, the boss fight of every act is replaced by bosses played by the vanilla playable characters (adjustable in the mod settings). They bring their own relics and decks, and play the cards of their own class. Unlike you, their plays are somewhat restricted — but they have more Max HP, and each of them has a unique special effect.

本模组的 Boss 说明已支持游戏的全部 16 种语言：简体中文 / 繁體中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어 / Русский / Polski / Deutsch / Français / Italiano / Español / Português (BR) / Türkçe / Bahasa Indonesia / ไทย。

本模组目前支持最多五人的联机，在装载观者mod后可以支持6人联机。多人联机时，不会增加Boss的生命值，而是会增加Boss的数量（Boss数量与玩家数量相同）。每位玩家都会被一名Boss锁定（添加“跟踪锁定”buff），该Boss的单体攻击、随机攻击、充能球、单体特殊效果都只会影响这一名玩家。Boss的群体攻击牌会攻击所有玩家。当一名Boss被击败时，被其锁定的玩家会解除锁定，只受到其他boss群体攻击的影响。当一名玩家被击败时，锁定他的boss会重新锁定剩余玩家中拥有“跟踪锁定”数量最少的玩家。

Boss descriptions are available in all 16 languages the game supports (Simplified/Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Polish, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish, Indonesian, Thai).

The mod currently supports multiplayer with up to five players — and up to six if a Watcher mod is installed. In multiplayer, boss HP is not increased — instead the number of bosses goes up (one boss per player). Every player is locked onto by one boss (granting the "Tracking Lock" buff): that boss's single-target attacks, random attacks, orbs and single-target special effects only ever affect that one player. Boss AoE attack cards hit every player. When a boss is defeated, the player it had locked onto is released and is afterwards only affected by other bosses' AoE attacks. When a player is defeated, the boss that had locked onto them re-locks onto the remaining player holding the fewest "Tracking Lock" stacks.

到目前为止，本模组一共添加了41个Boss（11/13/17），其中有6个是观者Boss，需要同时装载本模组和Boninall（3747526116）或Lamall（3747492505）的观者mod才会作为Boss出现（同时装载时优先使用Boninall版本的观者）。以后有可能会联动亡命之徒等其它模组角色。

So far the mod adds 41 bosses in total (11 / 13 / 17). Six of them are Watcher bosses: they only appear if this mod and a Watcher mod — either Boninall (3747526116) or Lamall (3747492505) — are both installed (if both are installed, the Boninall version takes priority). In the future we may also do crossovers with other modded characters such as The Hermit.

目前本模组的单人游戏较为稳定，但多人游戏仍有可能出现不同步等问题，并且为了兼顾单人和多人游戏，Boss强度很难平衡。因此，目前本模组会在玩家同意的情况下收集boss战的相关数据，用于进行平衡调整与bug修复，并且绝对不会收集与玩家隐私相关的内容。

Single-player is fairly stable at the moment, but multiplayer can still run into desyncs and similar problems, and balancing boss strength is difficult because the same numbers have to work for both solo and co-op. That is why, with the player's consent, the mod collects data about boss fights to help with balance tuning and bug fixing. It never collects anything related to player privacy.

由于boss的意图较为复杂，伤害总量计算较为困难，这一点在多人有多个boss的时候尤为明显。因此，本模组适配了薄荷尖塔（3737336234）的伤害预览，建议在游玩时装载该模组。

Because the bosses' intents are fairly complex, working out the total incoming damage is difficult — which is especially noticeable in multiplayer with several bosses on the field at once. The mod therefore supports the damage preview from Minty Spire 2 (薄荷尖塔, 3737336234), and installing it is recommended.

本模组的代码完全由Deepseek-Harness编写，我只是个总策划。在此，我还需要向所有在本模组制作过程中进行投稿、测试等帮助的朋友表达由衷的感谢！

All of the code in this mod was written by DeepSeek-Harness — I am merely the lead designer. I would also like to sincerely thank every friend who helped during development by contributing content, testing and so on!

本模组依赖BaseLib用于编写设置界面，若你未装载该模组，设置和联机等功能可能受到影响。

This mod depends on BaseLib for building its settings screen — if you do not have it installed, settings and multiplayer features may be affected.

若遇到bug，欢迎向作者反馈！反馈qq群：971526482；作者B站：疯狂的飞猪_

If you run into a bug, feel free to report it! Feedback QQ group: 971526482; the author's Bilibili: 疯狂的飞猪_

Credits / Disclaimer: this mod uses art assets from Slay the Spire 2 itself, music from Slay the Spire and Slay the Spire 2, and art assets from the Slay the Spire mod "Downfall". All of these assets remain the property of their respective creators (MegaCrit and the author(s) of Downfall). This mod is provided free of charge for non-commercial use only and is never sold in any form; upon request from the original authors, the related content can be removed at any time. Everything else (code, boss designs, etc.) is original to this mod, aside from a few bosses that take inspiration from bosses in Downfall.
